facts.fact: Daily News reports Tanzania Ports Authority's director of ICT saying the Tanzania Revenue Authority rolled out a new version of its customs system TANCIS in early 2025, with clearance requests filed online.
Daily News reports the Tanzania Ports Authority saying the port and TRA systems are fully connected through the TANESW single window, which links TRA, TBS, TMDA and GCLA on one platform.

TZA.note: Trade clearance system used by traders and agencies; no count of services or national portal stated.
Only technical support from the e-Government Authority is stated, not who runs or built the systems.
